description: Operators only: open a tunnel through a proxy (default: the current one) to each live relay and report, per relay, whether it worked and why not.

id.description:
Test the listed proxy with this id (its saved password is used).
With neither `id` nor `proxy`, the proxy in use is tested.

proxy.description:
The proxy to test (`socks5://`, `http://` or `https://`, optional
`user:password@`); empty for none.

name: check_proxy

RelayCheck.description: One relay reached (or not) through the proxy.

ms.description: Time to open the tunnel, when it opened.

reason.description: What it means, in a sentence.

proxy.description: The proxy that was checked, password hidden; empty for none.

description: Operators only: check every live relay now: does it connect, does it carry ContextVM events from one connection to another, and is it rate-limiting us.

detail.description: What went wrong, in one sentence; empty when nothing did.

forwards.description:
Whether a ContextVM event sent through the relay came back to a second
connection; `None` when it could not be tried.

ms.description: Round trip of the test event, in milliseconds.

status.description:
`ok` (every check passed), `degraded` (connects, but something failed)
or `down` (cannot connect).
